verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page lists "BYOC (your VPC) and Hybrid deployments", and the compliance docs refer to security controls "across all deployment options", which covers the in-your-own-VPC branch of the story. The evidence is only a pricing-page bullet with no deployment documentation, and nothing shows a fully self-hosted or air-gapped option. Zero data retention limits how long data is kept but does not keep documents inside your infrastructure. missing for 10: BYOC/VPC deployment documentation (architecture, setup, which components run in-VPC), fully self-hosted/on-prem or air-gapped option, clarity on which tier or plan includes BYOC, independent or hands-on corroboration of VPC deployments.
